subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT an internet browser?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Panda**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Panda** is a type of antivirus software, not an internet browser.
 
• Antivirus software is designed to detect, prevent, and remove malicious software from computers and networks.
 
• Examples of other antivirus software include Norton, McAfee, and Kaspersky.
 
• Internet browsers, such as Safari, Firefox, and Chrome, are used to access and navigate the World Wide Web.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Safari**

 
 
• Safari is a web browser developed by Apple Inc.
 
• It is the default browser on Apple devices such as iPhones, iPads, and Mac computers.
 
• Safari is known for its speed and energy efficiency.
 
• It supports modern web standards and has features like Intelligent Tracking Prevention to enhance user privacy.
 
 
 
• **Firefox**
 
 
• Firefox is a free and open-source web browser developed by the Mozilla Foundation.
 
• It is known for its strong privacy features and customization options.
 
• Firefox supports various add-ons and extensions that enhance browser functionality.
 
• It is available on multiple platforms including Windows, macOS, Linux, and mobile devices.
 
 
 
• **Chrome**
 
 
• Google Chrome is a cross-platform web browser developed by Google.
 
• It is the most widely used web browser worldwide.
 
• Chrome is known for its speed, simplicity, and security features.
 
• It supports a wide range of extensions and integrates seamlessly with other Google services.
 
 
 
• **Antivirus Software**
 
 
• Antivirus software is designed to protect computers from malware, viruses, and other malicious threats.
 
• It scans files and programs for known threats and removes or quarantines them to prevent damage.
 
• Modern antivirus software often includes additional features such as firewalls, email protection, and web browsing security.
 
• Examples of popular antivirus software include Panda, Norton, McAfee, and Kaspersky.
